meta.notes: A new liquid with its block (msm_examples:glow_honey) and its bucket (msm_examples:glow_honey_bucket), made from this one element. It behaves like water: it joins the water tag, so players and mobs swim in it, drown in it and are put out when burning. It flows one block every 20 ticks (tick_delay), finds slopes up to 2 blocks away (slope_distance) and loses 3 levels with every block it flows (drop_off); a gap between two pools fills up for good (infinite). It gives light of level 6. It is drawn with vanilla's moving water pictures under the tint #e8a828; give it pictures of its own in textures to change that; the bucket has a picture of its own. Its bucket fills an empty cauldron, which becomes msm_examples:glow_honey_cauldron with three levels as water's has (cauldron levels true); a glass bottle takes one level, or fills from a source, giving msm_examples:glow_honey_bottle, drunk in 1.6 seconds as a potion and giving minecraft:regeneration for 30 seconds (bottle effects). Anyone in it gets heal for three seconds: on_entity_inside names the event msm_examples:glow_honey_inside, declared in events, fired at most every ten ticks for each one inside. Fluids need the Fabric mod jar export.
